I’ll show you what got my attention in the research, why I stopped comparing my weight to other guys, and what changed for me after I got lean.

Most of the research I discuss was done in people with obesity or an existing medical condition. It leaves open whether healthy men who already have abs would benefit. I share my own experience in the video. Talk with a clinician about what’s appropriate for you.
